title: Oboe
summary: No render yet. One complete oboe tone-hole table exists (Nederveen and de Bruijn 1967, a Munnich oboe), but its bore is published only as graphs with diameters at the hole stations, and it carries no pad heights or fingering chart; the double reed also needs the paired-reed valve driver wired to a bore.
physics_present: generic fs-duct conical and cylindrical segments, tone-hole side branches and a flanged bell load, the lumped single-reed owner and the physical baffled outlet receiver already run for the clarinet; none has been given this instrument's geometry
Fuks and Sundberg 1996 blowing pressures for two professional oboe players are retained as player data
physics_missing: continuous bore profile and bell flare as numbers
pad and key heights, undercut geometry and a full fingering chart
a double-reed valve driving this bore (paired reed or the material-modal valve)
a modern specimen: the only complete table is from 1967
blocked: Bore profile is published only as figures; the 1967 transcription is also still unverified against the page images. Needs a digitised and checked bore, or a newer measured oboe from its authors.
